players.product: Microchannel liquid cold plates, liquid-cooling modules and high-performance thermal interface materials (graphene pads, liquid metal) for AI servers, plus vapor chambers, heat pipes and air-cooling modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy that, through its acquisition of Zhongshi Xunleng, it now has integrated R&D and supply capability for microchannel cold plates, liquid-cooling thermal modules and high-performance thermal interface materials (TIM), and that some of its microchannel liquid-cooling products have reached volume application in data-center AI servers; some liquid-cooling products are in batch supply. It said microchannel cold plates have become one of the important liquid-cooling routes as AI chip power keeps rising, and that it keeps increasing R&D, customer development and capacity building for liquid cooling while pushing customer introduction and product certification of liquid-cooling modules and core materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy that it has completed its technology reserve for diamond thermally conductive composite materials (diamond particles / powder as a high-conductivity filler in a polymer matrix, used as a high-performance TIM between the chip and the heat-dissipation parts) and masters the core powder-compounding and interface-modification processes; it is now optimizing performance, sampling customers and running reliability validation and application adaptation. It said the material is expected in future to be applicable to AI servers, high-performance computing, optical communication and consumer electronics, and it will advance R&D, customer validation and commercialization in line with market demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy that raw-material supply currently meets its production needs, backed by long-term supplier relationships and backup suppliers; it handles price swings through long-term purchase agreements, inventory management, multi-channel sourcing, process cost reduction and timely pricing adjustments. It said its product prices are stable overall and raw-material price fluctuations have a small overall impact on its operations.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy that it keeps long-term stable cooperation with its North American major customer in consumer-electronics thermal management, that its self-developed foldable graphite heat-spreading assembly has obtained global patent certification and can be used in foldable phones, and that it is advancing customer introduction, project validation and application of these products (customer and project details not disclosed for confidentiality).

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy that phase 1 of its Thailand base has reached mass production, has passed factory audits by several leading customers and is delivering multiple product categories in volume; construction of phase 2 has started and will proceed in step with downstream orders, market demand and project timing, to keep raising its nearby overseas delivery capacity.
